visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a light blue button-down shirt and small silver earrings, stands in a modern, neutral-toned interior. She speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions, gesturing with her right hand. (2) A screen recording of a social media thread in Chinese appears, discussing hair care costs. The woman's face is partially obscured by text overlays and screenshots. (3) The woman is back on screen in the same blue shirt, holding a single, small blue and gold capsule (hair mask) between her fingers, showcasing it closely to the lens. (4) The scene shifts to an outdoor setting where the woman is wearing a white sleeveless top. She leans on a red shopping cart outside a warehouse-style store with red and white striped awnings. (5) She holds a retail box of 'Pantene Intensive Shot' hair masks. The box is blue and white with images of the capsules. She gestures excitedly toward the product. (6) A montage shows her in a fitness studio performing Pilates exercises on a reformer machine. She wears a gray athletic set. Other people are visible in the background mirrors. (7) She is outdoors on a sidewalk, wearing a green tank top, holding her smartphone to show the time 12:03 PM. She runs her fingers through her sleek, shiny hair to demonstrate its texture. (8) At an outdoor cafe, she sits on a wooden bench in a blue halter top, holding a blue coffee cup with a straw. Her hair looks smooth as she turns her head. (9) Evening shot indoors; she shows her phone screen displaying 21:03 PM. She touches her hair to show it still looks fresh and voluminous after a full day. (10) A close-up shot shows her hands applying a white, creamy hair mask to wet, dark hair strands. (11) A split-screen 'Before and After' comparison shows her hair appearing frizzy and tangled on top versus smooth and glossy on the bottom. (12) She walks away from the camera down a busy city street wearing jeans and a white top, showing the movement of her hair. (13) Final indoor shot where she holds both the hair mask box and a matching gold and blue pump bottle of Pantene conditioner, smiling broadly.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator, 2 female students in the background of the gym, 1 male passerby outside the store, and several distant figures in the street scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A fashionable Asian woman with shoulder-length, dark brown hair with lighter highlights. She wears multiple outfits including a light blue collared shirt, a white halter top with jeans, a gray sports bra and leggings set, and a blue halter neck top.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves through various settings: a clean modern apartment with gray walls; a bright Pilates studio equipped with wooden reformer machines and floor-to-ceiling mirrors; the exterior of a Costco warehouse with red/white striped awnings; a sunny urban sidewalk; and a minimalist outdoor cafe bench.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A clear female voice begins speaking in a friendly, high-energy tone over a light, upbeat acoustic pop background track with steady percussion and acoustic guitar strumming. (2) The voice continues at a consistent pace, while soft 'pop' sound effects emphasize the appearance of text and screenshots on screen. (3) A subtle 'whoosh' sound transitions the scene outdoors, but the vocal tone remains energetic and the BGM continues uninterrupted. (4) The speaker's volume increases slightly when showing the product, with clear articulation. (5) As the Pilates montage begins, the BGM remains dominant while the voiceover provides a play-by-play of the 'durability test.' (6) Sounds of street ambience (distant traffic) are briefly audible beneath the clean vocal track. (7) The video concludes with the speaker reaching a persuasive, conclusive tone, summarizing the benefits with a slight rise in pitch for the final CTA.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Comparison -> Social Proof -> Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review for Pantene hair masks. The creator highlights the high cost of professional salon hair treatments and positions this product as a high-quality, budget-friendly alternative that can be used at home. Through a day-long durability test involving a workout and outdoor activities, she demonstrates the product's effectiveness in keeping hair smooth and voluminous in hot weather.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product display, brand naming in speech and text, and a concluding call to action to buy the product.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-density text overlays and a fast-paced 'a-day-in-the-life' format to build trust and demonstrate practical utility. The use of B5 and hyaluronic acid as technical buzzwords targets skincare-conscious consumers.
